eventDetail.scope: IEEE ISMAR is the premier international conference on Augmented Reality (AR), Mixed Reality (MR), and related immersive technologies, including Virtual Reality (VR). It brings together researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to present advances in fundamental technologies, interactive systems, human-centered design, real-world applications. The conference welcomes contributions on computer vision, tracking and localization, sensing, display and optical technologies, rendering, AI and machine learning, human-computer interaction, perception and cognition, user experience, collaborative and telepresence systems, content creation, and spatial computing. ISMAR also covers applications in healthcare, education, manufacturing, architecture, entertainment, cultural heritage, robotics, and other domains. Submissions should demonstrate a clear and significant contribution to AR, MR, VR, or extended reality (XR) technologies, systems, experiences, or their practical deployment.
